english_retrieval.title: Covid 19 India Cases Highlights: 783 Covid patients recover, active cases in Delhi shrink by 37
english_retrieval.snippet: ## Six Covid-19-related deaths were reported -- one each in Delhi, Kerala, Jharkhand and Maharashtra, and two Karnataka. As many as 783 patients were cured/discharged/migrated from across the country till this morning, as per the official website, as per the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The total number of active Covid-19 cases in India touched 6,815, as of 8 am on Tuesday, as the number of active cases increased by 324. Six new Covid-19-related deaths were reported — one each in Delhi, Kerala, Jharkhand and Maharashtra, and two Karnataka. It is followed by Gujarat, West Bengal and Delhi according to the MoHFW data, with the Capital reporting a reduction in the number of active Covid-19 cases from 728 on Monday to 691 today. West Bengal reported no new Covid-19 cases in the last 24 hours, as per the data on the website of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare on Tuesday.
